status_note: LP-1 to LP-6 are ratified and the owner's confirmation of 2026-09-11 is recorded (ADR §0.3). LP-7 (2026-09-11, ADR section 0.4) designed the NON-PRODUCTION step-8 infrastructure and supplied no value; the offline step-7 artifacts it permits (ruling 11) exist in ugence-model-egress-validation and can mark no infrastructure-dependent row. Steps 4 and 6 are built (unit 0.3.0: migration 2, migrator identity, tenant-bound identities, durable reservation; adapter 0.1.0 with an injected fake transport only). No row can execute: the GCP project, workload identity, secret-version resource, IAM binding, audit-log evidence, rotation procedure and OpenAI organization/project identifiers are undesignated (step 8); the live transport, the owner-run verifier and the acceptance-report generator are unbuilt (step 7); no credential is commissioned (step 9). Fake-transport tests pass in CI and mark no row here: fake evidence cannot satisfy a live row. Rows are executed only on the owner's machine by a verifier that never prints the credential or the full request content, and MET is the outcome reached only by the owner's separate acceptance statement after the validation's evidence; the validation call itself needs the two predecessor gates of ADR section 0.5, never MET; a successful HTTP response alone is insufficient (LP-4).

genuine_call_gate.rule: ADR section 0.6: a genuine call is admitted only by ugence_model_egress_unit.authorization.admit_genuine_call, which issues a GenuineCallAdmission after six conditions hold and the durable ledger has consumed the attempt before dispatch; EgressResult refuses genuine_call true without a verified admission for that request, and the database (migration 3) refuses a genuine row without its consumption. MET is the outcome the validation's evidence feeds, never a prerequisite of row 12.
conditions: 1 G1 from this record: meu_live_status is PENDING_VALIDATION (every one of the seventeen step-8 obligations independently verified) or MET
2 the typed LiveSyntheticValidationAuthorization is present, well-formed, and is the one this record pins in live_synthetic_validation_authorization (its digest)

3 every scope field matches the proposed request and the current step-8 designations: authorizing owner, NON_PRODUCTION environment, OpenAI organization, project and service-account IDs, provider, pinned model, exact endpoint, the exact designation-record digest, the exact validation-plan digest, the request's digest within the authorized set, the request within the authorized token limits
4 the authorization is within its issue/expiry window and its digest is not in revoked_authorization_digests
5 its nonce has not been replayed (durable ledger)
6 the durable reservation ledger proves remaining call and budget capacity; the attempt is then consumed durably, before dispatch, and an ambiguous dispatch keeps the consumption
genuine_call_gate.never_sufficient: a non-empty string, a boolean, an owner's name, or an altered release constant
genuine_call_gate.after_the_sequence: further genuine calls stay refused unless separately authorized; expiry, revocation, the call limit or a transition to MET never create or extend an authorization
